title: Sequence Plan
description: Ordered sequences (groups of scenes) for a narrative-film production. The grouping layer between the script and the shot-level scene_plan; typically derived from the script during breakdown.

act_id.description: References an act in the story artifact

primary_location_id.description: References a location in the locations artifact

cast_ids.description: Character ids (from cast) appearing in this sequence

scene_ids.description: Scene/shot ids (from scene_plan) belonging to this sequence; populated once the shot list is built
